newsitem.title: USA: Battle Mountain CFO, two others resign.
newsitem.headline: Battle Mountain CFO, two others resign.

text.p: Battle Mountain Gold Co said Monday that its chief financial officer and two other officers have "voluntarily elected to resign" from the company as a result of its merger with Hemlo Gold Mines Inc.
The company said the three officers resigned under terms of a "change-of-control" severance agreement related to the July 1996 merger.
The officers involved are Chief Financial Officer R. Dennis O'Connell; Robert Quinn, vice president, general counsel and secretary; and Fred Reisbick, vice president of exploration.
Battle Mountain Chairman Karl Elers said in a statement that the three officers will continue to work with the company during a transition period until their duties have been passed along to others.
The discretionary window to voluntarily resign from the company and receive severance payments under the agreement ends March 16, the company said.
